# App shell: `jl-app-shell`

The frame of an app: top bar, sidebar, scrolling main area and side panel, with a drawer and a tab bar when narrow.

- Class `JlAppShell`, a template: `import { JlAppShell } from '@syware/jlib';`
- On the site: https://bioleyl.github.io/jlib/components/app-shell

The frame of an app: a top bar across (slot header), a sidebar (slot nav), the main area (the default
slot) and an optional panel on the right (slot aside). Only the main area scrolls; the bars stay. The shell takes
the height of its container, so give that one a height: 100dvh for a whole page, a fixed height in a preview.

The shell measures its own width, not the window's (a container query): narrower than 960 pixels, the sidebar
becomes a drawer that slides over the content with a scrim, a menu button appears at the start of the top bar, and
the right panel steps aside. The drawer opens with that button, with nav-open, or with toggleNav(); Escape, the
scrim, following a link or a select from the nav (a jl-side-nav's) closes it.

On phones, the main places go in a bar along the bottom (slot tabs, a jl-tab-bar): it shows only when narrow, and
its more button opens the drawer with the rest. A shell that fills the window then writes the bar's height on the
document as --jl-shell-bottom: toasts keep above it by themselves, and a page's floating bar or button can too, with
bottom: calc(var(--jl-shell-bottom, 0px) + 16px).

## Use

```ts
import { JlAppShell, JlBadge, JlButton, JlCodeBlock, JlIcon, JlInput, JlSideNav } from '@syware/jlib';
```

```tsx
<JlAppShell>
  <div slot="header" style="display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px">
      <strong style="display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px"><JlIcon name="rocket" size={18} /> Launchpad</strong>
      <JlInput icon="search" size="sm" placeholder="Search" label="Search" />
      <JlButton variant="ghost" icon="bell" hint="Notifications" />
    </div>
    <JlSideNav slot="nav" value="website" sections={[{"items":[{"icon":"house","id":"home","label":"Home"},{"badge":4,"icon":"inbox","id":"inbox","label":"Inbox"}]},{"items":[{"children":[{"id":"website","label":"Website"},{"id":"mobile-app","label":"Mobile app"}],"icon":"folder","id":"projects","label":"Projects"},{"icon":"chart","id":"reports","label":"Reports"},{"icon":"settings","id":"settings","label":"Settings"}],"label":"Workspace"}]} />
    <div style="display: grid; gap: 12px; max-width: 640px; padding: 24px; line-height: 1.55">
      <h2 style="margin: 0; font-size: 20px">Website</h2>
      <p style="margin: 0; color: var(--jl-muted)">The main area scrolls on its own: the top bar and the sidebar stay.</p>
      <JlCodeBlock language="bash" code="npm run build" />
      <p style="margin: 0">Last deployed two hours ago from the main branch. Previews are built for every pull request
      and kept for a week; production deploys wait for a review.</p>
      <p style="margin: 0">Visitors this week: 12,480, up 8% on last week. Most come from search, then from the
      newsletter.</p>
      <p style="margin: 0">Three alerts are open: one for the image service, two for slow pages on mobile.</p>
      <p style="margin: 0">Domains: example.com and www.example.com, with certificates renewed automatically.</p>
      <p style="margin: 0">Environment variables: 14, of which 3 are secrets shared with the preview builds.</p>
      <p style="margin: 0">Build minutes this month: 312 of 1,000. The longest build took four minutes, the
      shortest forty seconds.</p>
      <p style="margin: 0; color: var(--jl-muted)">The end of the page.</p>
    </div>
    <div slot="aside" style="display: grid; gap: 8px; width: 220px; padding: 20px 16px; font-size: 13px">
      <strong>Details</strong>
      <span style="color: var(--jl-muted)">Owner: Ada Lovelace</span>
      <span style="color: var(--jl-muted)">Region: Zurich</span>
      <JlBadge tone="ok" dot label="Healthy" />
    </div>
</JlAppShell>
```

## Properties

Inputs: a JSX prop sets one, code calls `.set(value)` and `.get()`, HTML writes the attribute (lists and objects as JSON).

- `navOpen` (attribute `nav-open`): `boolean`, default `false`. Whether the drawer is open, when the shell is narrow; wide, the sidebar always shows.
- `narrowHeader` (attribute `narrow-header`): `boolean`, default `false`. Shows the top bar only when the shell is narrow, with the menu button and the header slot (the app's name); wide, the side nav's header names the app, as the navigation pattern lays it out.

## Events

In JSX, the `on…` prop, its handler given the detail; in code, `events.register(name, (detail) => …)`. They do not bubble.

- `navtoggle` (`onNavtoggle` in JSX), detail `boolean`: People opened or closed the drawer: whether it is open.

## Slots

- `header`: The top bar: a brand, a search, the account. The menu button comes before it when narrow.
- `nav`: The sidebar, such as a jl-side-nav; a drawer when narrow.
- The default slot: The main area, which scrolls.
- `aside`: A panel on the right, for details; hidden when narrow.
- `tabs`: A bar along the bottom, such as a jl-tab-bar; shown only when narrow.

## Methods

- `toggleNav(force?: boolean): void`: Opens or closes the drawer; force sets the state instead of flipping it.

## Styling

- `--header-height` (custom property): The least height of the top bar (56px).
- `--drawer-width` (custom property): The widest the drawer gets (300px, or 86% of the shell).
- `base` (part, `::part(base)`): The grid of the whole frame.
- `header` (part, `::part(header)`): The top bar.
- `nav` (part, `::part(nav)`): The sidebar, or the drawer.
- `main` (part, `::part(main)`): The main area.
- `aside` (part, `::part(aside)`): The right panel.
- `tabs` (part, `::part(tabs)`): The bottom bar.

## Examples

HTML as the site renders it, with its layout classes (`row`, `stack`, `narrow`, `muted`), which are not jlib's: a view writes the same components by class in JSX. A script's `root` is the example's element.

### An app

Top bar, side nav, content and a details panel. The preview is drawn at 80%, so the shell is wide enough for its sidebar.

```html
      <div style="height: 420px; border: 1px solid var(--jl-line); border-radius: var(--jl-radius-lg); overflow: hidden">
        <div style="zoom: 0.8; height: 525px">
          <jl-app-shell>
<div slot="header" style="display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px">
  <strong style="display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px"><jl-icon name="rocket" size="18"></jl-icon> Launchpad</strong>
  <jl-input icon="search" size="sm" placeholder="Search" label="Search" style="flex: 0 1 240px; margin-left: auto"></jl-input>
  <jl-button variant="ghost" icon="bell" hint="Notifications"></jl-button>
</div>
<jl-side-nav slot="nav" value="website" sections='[{"items":[{"icon":"house","id":"home","label":"Home"},{"badge":4,"icon":"inbox","id":"inbox","label":"Inbox"}]},{"items":[{"children":[{"id":"website","label":"Website"},{"id":"mobile-app","label":"Mobile app"}],"icon":"folder","id":"projects","label":"Projects"},{"icon":"chart","id":"reports","label":"Reports"},{"icon":"settings","id":"settings","label":"Settings"}],"label":"Workspace"}]'></jl-side-nav>
<div style="display: grid; gap: 12px; max-width: 640px; padding: 24px; line-height: 1.55">
  <h2 style="margin: 0; font-size: 20px">Website</h2>
  <p style="margin: 0; color: var(--jl-muted)">The main area scrolls on its own: the top bar and the sidebar stay.</p>
  <jl-code-block language="bash" code="npm run build"></jl-code-block>
  <p style="margin: 0">Last deployed two hours ago from the main branch. Previews are built for every pull request
  and kept for a week; production deploys wait for a review.</p>
  <p style="margin: 0">Visitors this week: 12,480, up 8% on last week. Most come from search, then from the
  newsletter.</p>
  <p style="margin: 0">Three alerts are open: one for the image service, two for slow pages on mobile.</p>
  <p style="margin: 0">Domains: example.com and www.example.com, with certificates renewed automatically.</p>
  <p style="margin: 0">Environment variables: 14, of which 3 are secrets shared with the preview builds.</p>
  <p style="margin: 0">Build minutes this month: 312 of 1,000. The longest build took four minutes, the
  shortest forty seconds.</p>
  <p style="margin: 0; color: var(--jl-muted)">The end of the page.</p>
</div>
<div slot="aside" style="display: grid; gap: 8px; width: 220px; padding: 20px 16px; font-size: 13px">

  <jl-badge tone="ok" dot label="Healthy" style="justify-self: start"></jl-badge>
</div>
          </jl-app-shell>
```
